notes.title: Patch on November 3
Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint is Out Now on Steam!!!
notes.content:
[h3][b] 🔪 The Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint is now on Steam! 🔪 [/b][/h3]

[b]Prepare for relentless action in this hardcore side-scrolling beat-'em-up masterpiece![/b]

[previewyoutube=V3t5xb9Ztg0;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into Mr. Peppermint's shoes, a detective on a mission to unveil puppeteers behind the criminal underworld. Driven by an unquenchable thirst for revenge, nothing stands in his way. The line between vengeance and madness blurs, leading to a dark and twisted narrative, full of paradoxes and unanswered questions.

[b]Being a small indie studio, we truly understand the mighty power of our community, and you can help us in numerous ways:[/b]

💥 [b]Share with Friends:[/b]
Spread the word to your fellow gamers. Let them know the game is here; they won't want to miss out on the action!

🌟 [b]Steam Reviews:[/b]
After you've played, consider leaving a review on Steam. Your feedback helps fellow vengeance seekers and assist us in refining the game.

💥 [b]Share on Social Media:[/b]
Share your in-game adventures and connect with fellow players by using #VengeanceofMrPeppermint. 

If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, we'd love to hear from you. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/XqHquCBBfv]Discord[/url] community and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/HackPublisher]Twitter[/url] for the latest updates and to connect with fellow players and us, the devs. We're all ears and ready to make your gaming experience even better!
 
Get ready to leave a bloody trail behind, and thank you for being part of the journey!

notes.title: Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint Launches Oct 23rd!!
notes.content:
🔪 [b]Get Ready, The Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint arrives on Steam October 23rd![/b] 🔪 

We've got a BRAND NEW release date announcement trailer!! 

[previewyoutube=_FY8Gf0MW64;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendars for this hardcore, side-scrolling beat-'em-up that draws inspiration from classic Korean crime dramas. As Mr. Peppermint, a relentless detective driven by a thirst for revenge, your mission is clear: Uncover the puppeteers at the helm of the criminal underworld and deliver ruthless justice.

[h3][b]🕵️‍♂️ Detective's Vendetta:[/b][/h3]
In a chilling turn of events, a serial killer abducted two innocent siblings. Now, two decades later, the boy who escaped that horror has grown into a detective, a believer in the rule of law. [i][b]But his quest for vengeance has taken him to the edge of madness.[/b][/i] With fiery determination, he'll stop at nothing to avenge his sister's death, even if it means taking on the whole criminal network.

[h3][b]🔥🩸 Over-the-Top Action:[/b][/h3]
Mr. Peppermint's relentless pursuit of vengeance has transformed him into an unstoppable force. Utilize precise controls to execute deadly combos and unleash brutal fatalities. The environment becomes your arsenal, with improvised weapons like meat processors, ovens, and more, all in the name of bringing an end to criminal careers.
[h3][b]
💔 A Twisted Tale:[/b][/h3]
However, be forewarned – as Mr. Peppermint's actions take a toll, the narrative takes a darker turn, and his psyche begins to unravel. Paradoxes, unanswered questions, and inconsistencies come to light. Is Mr. Peppermint becoming the very thing he seeks to destroy?

"Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint" hits Steam on October 23rd. Add the game to your Steam wishlist now to ensure you're among the first to dive into this revenge-fueled adventure.

notes.title: Seek Vengeance During Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Greetings Mr. Peppermint, 

Get ready to dive headfirst into the abyss of vengeance during Next Fest from October 9 at 10 AM PST to October 16.

[h3][b][b]🩸 Play the Demo: [/b][/b][/h3]
Next Fest grants you the chance to download and immerse yourself in the demo, assuming the gritty mantle of a hard-boiled detective on a relentless quest for bloody justice. Unleash your fury as you bulldoze through the criminal underworld, leaving chaos in your wake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44044323/024f41c36099bba76fc6b093ec19df7e5140866d.gif[/img]

Will you emerge unscathed, or descend further into the madness? Will vengeance consume your every thought, or can redemption be found amid the turbulent chaos?

Once you've navigated a sea of corpses and wiped the blood from your suit, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/XqHquCBBfv?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=community]Discord[/url]. There, brief us on your favorite combos, share stories of improvised weapons, and discuss your unwavering pursuit of justice. Stay  up-to-date with us by following us on social media. 

[url=https://twitter.com/HackPublisher?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=community]Twitter [/url]

The darkness awaits, detective.
